chronology: The manuscript v1.7.4 and its outcomes had already been inspected when these studies were chosen. This is an author revision study, not external preregistration and not a replacement of N or original DV.
failure_policy: Retain all outcomes. Stop on integrity or numerical failure, preserve evidence, never substitute favorable seeds. Resource interruptions resume the same predefined task.
purpose: Targeted finite repeated-downstream-learning study for the original three DV contrasts, conditional on the existing N PCA and generator; not full-pipeline PCA-training stability.
budget_rationale: Fixed limited extension rather than a power-derived number or a journal rule. Five distinct learning/calibration samples allow transparent observed dispersion; they cannot precisely estimate the probability that a future fit succeeds. No claim of global training stability is permitted.
normal_training_PCA: reuse exact original N PCA and residual basis; do not refit
